name: Mat'Selesnya
description: Entity of the guild who slept in Vitu-Ghazi and told Trostani the tree needed space to lay new roots.

description_citations.text: "Vitu-Ghazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szadek manipulates Savra and the Selesnya Conclave into killing Mat'Selesnya.
timeline.quote: manipulating Savra and the Selesnya Conclave to do his bidding and kill Mat'Selesnya

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Decamillennial the Selesnya lose their connection to the World Tree and rely on a high council; Mat'Selesnya goes dormant within Vitu-Ghazi and Suniel helps three dryads fuse into Trostani.
timeline.quote: Suniel helped three Dryad sisters to fuse into Trostani to function as the direct voice of Mat'Selesnya and as the new guildmaster.

citation.text: "Selesnya Conclave", section "Leadership". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Suniel binds the sisters' essence within a tree and they reach the Worldsoul, who commands them to grow an army.
timeline.quote: Suniel bound their essence within a tree

citation.text: "Suniel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mat'Selesnya completes the spell, bonding the dryads to all trees of Ravnica; Suniel cannot save them.
timeline.quote: watch helplessly as the three sisters disappeared into the oaks

citation.text: "Suniel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szadek partially uproots Vitu-Ghazi during the Decamillennial to drink from Mat'Selesnya.
timeline.quote: uprooted partially by Szadek so he could drink from Mat'Selesnya

citation.text: "Vitu-Ghazi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Selesnyan leaders prepare to perform the convocation to bless Ravnica on the day of the Decamillennial.
timeline.quote: prepared to perform the convocation, a sacred ritual intended to bless the entire plane

citation.text: "Decamillennial", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szadek tears open Vitu-Ghazi and feeds on Mat'Selesnya.

citation.text: "Decamillennial", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Fonn places Bayul's gem on her dying wolf Biracazir, reviving the Chorus and Mat'Selesnya, whose power destroys the shapeshifters and leaves Szadek a charred husk.
timeline.quote: she placed it on her mortally wounded wolf , Biracazir .

citation.text: "Decamillennial", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szadek is defeated thanks to Jarad and Mat'Selesnya reinvigorated by Biracazir's lifeforce.
timeline.quote: Szadek was defeated thanks to Jarad

citation.text: "Fonn Zunich", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Three dryad sisters, Cim, Oba and Ses, try to make contact with Mat'Selesnya in a trance and report that she is in a giant web but cannot be reached.
timeline.quote: She's there in that giant web, I know it.

citation.text: "The Great Concourse". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Mat'Selesnya speaks to Cim and tells her to raise an army to stop the ambitions of the rootless ones and the scheming dragon.
timeline.quote: And then, in a voice as clear as a crystal bell, Mat'Selesnya spoke.

citation.text: "The Great Concourse". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Mat'Selesnya warns that the sisters will bond with all the trees of Ravnica and can never return; Cim agrees.
timeline.quote: Cim looked at her sisters. "We understand, Great Mother."

citation.text: "The Great Concourse". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The three dryad sisters enter a trance to reconnect with Mat'Selesnya; Suniel binds them to an old oak and the Parun fuses them with the World Tree, creating Trostani.
timeline.quote: this old Parun fused the three dryads with the World Tree, creating Trostani.

citation.text: "Trostani", section "Creation of Trostani". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emmara represents the Selesnya at Niv-Mizzet's resurrection; three years later she regains control of the guild when Trostani is implicated in the Karlov Manor murders.
timeline.quote: Tandris regained control of the guild

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kellan explains that Vitu-Ghazi was moved to the moor to recover after the invasion.
timeline.quote: Mat'Selesnya told Trostani that Vitu-Ghazi needed space to put down new root structures

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 5: Chains of Expectation
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 5: Chains of Expectation" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya realizes Oba is drawing on the Ravnican Worldsoul itself.
timeline.quote: She was drawing directly on the Ravnican Worldsoul, Mat'Selesnya, ripping strength from the very plane and using it against the people she had designated her enemies.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Szadek triggers his plan to kill Mat'Selesnya at the Decamillennial; Jarad and Kos stop it and Kos arrests the Dimir guildleader.
timeline.quote: Kos arrested the Dimir guildleader to answer for his crimes

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Life in the Wojek". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vitu-Ghazi is replanted in a moor within a park on Selesnya territory around a manor-library.
timeline.quote: The tree was planted around a manor

citation.text: "Vitu-Ghazi", section "Replanting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: to function as the direct voice of Mat'Selesnya and as the new guildmaster.
